# @rxova/react-tags-input

> A headless, accessible tag / token input for React: delimiters, paste splitting,
> length and duplicate rules, a real roving tab order over the tags, and add and
> remove announced to screen readers. The value is a `string[]`. Zero runtime
> dependencies. No stylesheet to import.

## Install

    npm install @rxova/react-tags-input

`react >= 18` is the only peer dependency.

## Minimal working example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { TagsInput } from '@rxova/react-tags-input'

export function Topics() {
  const [tags, setTags] = useState<string[]>([])

  return <TagsInput label="Topics" value={tags} onChange={setTags} placeholder="Add a topic" />
}
```

A refused entry stays in the box so the user can fix it, and the reason arrives
through `onReject`:

```tsx
import { TagsInput, type TagAttempt } from '@rxova/react-tags-input'

export function Constrained() {
  return (
    <TagsInput
      label="Topics"
      max={5}
      minLength={2}
      maxLength={20}
      transform={(raw) => raw.toLowerCase()}
      validate={(tag, existing) =>
        existing.length > 0 && tag === 'other' ? 'pick something specific' : true
      }
      onReject={(attempt: TagAttempt) => {
        console.log(attempt.reason, attempt.message)
      }}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

`<TagsInput>` — the full surface is `TagsInputProps` in the published types.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string[]` | — | Controlled list of tags. |
| `defaultValue` | `string[]` | — | Uncontrolled initial list. Ignored when `value` is set. |
| `onChange` | `(tags: string[]) => void` | — | The whole list, after every accepted add or remove. |
| `onAdd` | `(tag: string, tags: string[]) => void` | — | Once per tag actually added, after it passed every rule. |
| `onRemove` | `(tag: string, index: number, tags: string[]) => void` | — | With the index it occupied. |
| `onReject` | `(attempt: TagAttempt) => void` | — | A candidate that was refused, with a machine-readable reason. |
| `delimiters` | `string[]` | `['Enter', ',']` | Keys and characters that commit the current text. `'Tab'` is opt-in. |
| `splitPaste` | `boolean` | `true` | Split a paste on the delimiters, and on newlines regardless. |
| `addOnBlur` | `boolean` | `true` | Commit whatever is in the box when focus leaves. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | Text in the entry box. |
| `trim` | `boolean` | `true` | Strip leading and trailing whitespace. |
| `allowDuplicates` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `caseSensitive` | `boolean` | `false` | Compare case-sensitively when deduplicating. |
| `max` | `number` | — | Maximum number of tags. |
| `minLength` | `number` | — | Minimum length of one tag, in codepoints. |
| `maxLength` | `number` | — | Maximum length of one tag, in codepoints. |
| `transform` | `(raw: string) => string` | — | Rewrites an entry before it is checked. |
| `validate` | `(tag: string, existing: string[]) => boolean \| string` | — | Final say; a string is the refusal message. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Accessible name for the field. **Not rendered** — supply your own `<label htmlFor={`${id}-input`}>` for a visible one. |
| `removeLabel` | `(tag: string) => string` | ``Remove ${tag}`` | Accessible name for a tag's remove button. |
| `renderTag` | `(state: TagState) => ReactNode` | the tag text | Custom rendering for one tag's contents. |
| `announce` | `(event: { type: 'add' \| 'remove' \| 'reject'; tag: string; tags: string[] }) => string` | `Added ${tag}, 3 tags` | Live-region text. Return `''` to say nothing. |
| `className` | `string` | — | |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | — | |
| `name` | `string` | — | Emits one hidden input per tag, so a native `<form>` posts an array. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `dir` | `'ltr' \| 'rtl'` | inherited | |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | `false` | Focuses the entry box on mount. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Accessible name when there is no `label`. Wins over `label`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`. |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | — | ids of external error/help text. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Base id; the list, entry box and live region derive theirs from it. |
| `onBlur` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | — | Fires when focus leaves the whole field, never between its parts. |
| `onFocus` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | — | |
| `onWarn` | `(warning: TagsWarning) => void` | `console.warn` | Development-only notice that a prop was coerced. Stripped from production builds. |

Also exported: the `useTagsInput` hook (its result carries `clear()`, which
empties the tags and the entry box together) and the pure helpers `attempt`,
`attemptAll`, `sanitize`, `comparable`, `contains`, `splitPasted`.

## Styling

There is no stylesheet. Set CSS custom properties on any ancestor:
`--rx-tags-gap`, `--rx-tags-tag-gap`, `--rx-tags-tag-padding`, `--rx-tags-tag-radius`,
`--rx-tags-tag-background`, `--rx-tags-remove-size`.

Keep `--rx-tags-remove-size` at `1.5rem` or above: at the default font size that is
the 24×24 CSS pixels WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) requires.

Or target the `data-*` attributes, which are public API covered by semver:
`data-rx-tags-root`, `data-rx-tags-list`, `data-rx-tags-tag`, `data-rx-tags-label`,
`data-rx-tags-remove`, `data-rx-tags-input`, `data-rx-tags-value`, `data-rx-tags-announcement`,
plus the state hooks `data-count`, `data-full`, `data-focused`, `data-disabled`,
`data-readonly`, `data-invalid`.

## Three mistakes to avoid

1. **Treating a rejection as a value change.** A refused candidate never reaches
   `onChange`; it stays in the entry box and reports through `onReject` with a
   `reason` code, so the user can correct the text instead of retyping it.
2. **Filtering duplicates yourself in `onChange`.** Deduplication happens before
   a tag is accepted — `allowDuplicates` and `caseSensitive` control it. Filtering
   after the fact fights the component and drops the `onAdd`/`onReject` pairing.
3. **Expecting one form field.** With `name` set, the component emits one hidden
   input per tag, which is how a native `<form>` posts an array. It is not a
   single comma-joined string.
